title: Retriever task packet
description: Doc 05 section 4. One packet per Planner assignment. All five retrievers share it and differ only in connector and doctrine, which is what lets the harness fan out over a list without knowing what any of them does.

sq_id.description: The Planner sub-question this assignment serves. Null on a card that needed no plan.

filters.description: Narrowing the connector understands. Doc 05 section 8.3: version_ref defaults to the version in force at the run date.

exclude_board_id.description: Doc 05 section 8.5: the boards retriever never recalls from the board it is asked on.

must_exclude.description: Doctrine and profile exclusions, already merged. Doc 05 section 15's exclude_paths hook enforces these before any fetch, and a violation is a hard failure rather than a caveat.

must_include.description: Doc 17 section 5: a learning path's `sources_hint` locators, so a lesson reads what the path was written around. Not the twin of must_exclude: an exclusion is a rule a retriever may not break, and this is a place it is told to look first. A locator that answers nothing still contributes nothing.

trust_ranks.description: Doc 05 section 5: trust_rank is set from doctrine, never by the retriever's own judgment.
